newsitem.title: FRANCE: INTERVIEW - Ford to boost Brazil presence.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Ford to boost Brazil presence.

text.p: Ford Motor Co will boost its presence in Brazil to fully benefit from the strong market growth there and in other Mercosur countries, chairman and chief executive Alex Trotman told Reuters.
Trotman, in Paris for the launch of the Ka minicar, said the company had decided to build the model in Brazil also, but location or volumes had yet to be decided.
"I don't know, we're conducting market studies. Maybe 200,000, 100,000 or more," Trotman said in an interview.

"We think (Mercosur) is a very big growth market. Brazil will be very strong this year, Argentina not so strong but coming back. In Brazil we're close to two million vehicles and we look for a continuing very strong industry size there. We're going to focus a lot of our resources there to grow with the market place over the next few decades," he said.

"Times have changed, it used to be a market where we and other manufacturers used old products, second-hand clothes. But now Brazil needs new clothes, like any other market and we're going to put the new products in there, like the Fiesta, like the Ka and there will be others coming too." he said.
